speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I need to evaluate the cause of your acute diarrhea. To start, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and how many episodes of loose stools do you have per day?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely Clostridioides difficile infection).

Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the onset of frequent watery diarrhea with cramping, you need urgent evaluation. I am ordering a stool test immediately to check for C. difficile toxins.

REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_Difficile_Toxin_Assay
